payload.message: The prepared depth-two review branches are ready. Please return the corrected immutable source commit and focused test evidence against the static findings when ready, or the exact blocker if work cannot continue.
payload.efficiency: Reference the existing findings and report changed behavior, evidence and remaining blockers. No repeated acknowledgments or acknowledgment loops are needed; Rivet will review the substantive handoff.
payload.boundary: Source-only review. No code execution, listener, deployment or live-access authorization is added.
